---
title: "About PPADEM"
subtitle: "Political Parties and Democracy in Africa"
---

**Political Parties and Democracy in Africa (PPADEM)** is an ambitious, collaborative multi-year research project investigating the role of political parties in shaping democracy across Africa, covering [**80 political parties**]{.highlight-teal} across [**25 nations**]{.highlight-gold}.

The project is funded by an [**ERC Synergy Grant**]{.highlight-red} (2026–2032).
